cinematic.faq1_q: What makes this different from AI chatbots?
cinematic.faq1_a: This is not a chatbot frontend. It is a distributed autonomous revenue infrastructure platform.
cinematic.faq2_a: No. Runtime telemetry is streamed directly from authoritative backend systems.
cinematic.faq3_q: Does the system support MTProto orchestration?
cinematic.faq3_a: Yes. Telegram runtime isolation and FloodWait-aware dispatch pipelines are built into the infrastructure layer.
cinematic.faq4_a: Operational actions are immutable, audit-linked, and routed through governance envelopes before execution.
